00012| import { normalizePrompt } from './crate/engine.mjs';

00015| import { renderResponse } from './crate/seed.mjs';

00022| const MARKER_REACH = 3;
00023| const CHANGE_ROLES = ['file_write_action_cue', 'file_edit_action_cue', 'coding_text_remove_action'];
00024| const isIdentifierChar = (character) => /^[A-Za-z0-9_$]$/u.test(character);

00026| /**
00027|  * Mirrors `fn export_question` in rust/src/agentic_coding/module_exports.rs:
00028|  * the module an export question names, or null.
00029|  * @param {string} task
00030|  */
00031| export function exportQuestion(task) {
00032|   const normalized = normalizePrompt(task);
00033|   if (!mentionsRole('module_export_question', normalized) || !mentionsRole('coding_declaration_noun', normalized)
00034|     // A request that changes the module (add an exported function) is not a question about it.
00035|     || CHANGE_ROLES.some((role) => mentionsRole(role, normalized))) {
00036|     return null;
00037|   }
00038|   return pathsIn(task)[0] ?? null;
00039| }

00041| /**
00042|  * Mirrors `fn exported_functions`: the names of the functions `source`
00043|  * declares behind a seeded export marker, each once, in order.
00044|  * @param {string} source
00045|  */
00046| export function exportedFunctions(source) {
00047|   const markers = wordsForRole('module_export_marker');
00048|   const keywords = wordsForRole('function_declaration_keyword');
00049|   const names = [];
00050|   for (const line of source.split('\n')) {
00051|     const words = splitWhitespace(line);
00052|     if (!words.length || !markers.includes(words[0])) continue;
00053|     const at = words.findIndex((word, index) => index > 0 && index <= MARKER_REACH && keywords.includes(word));
00054|     if (at < 0 || at + 1 >= words.length) continue;
00055|     const chars = Array.from(words[at + 1]);
00056|     const end = chars.findIndex((character) => !isIdentifierChar(character));
00057|     const name = chars.slice(0, end < 0 ? chars.length : end).join('');
00058|     if (name !== '' && !names.includes(name)) names.push(name);
00059|   }
00060|   return names;
00061| }

00063| /**
00064|  * Mirrors `fn plan_module_exports_step`.
00065|  * @param {string} task
00066|  * @param {Array<object>} messages
00067|  * @param {Array<string>} toolNames

00069| export function planModuleExportsStep(task, messages, toolNames) {
00070|   const path = exportQuestion(task);
00071|   if (path === null) return null;
00072|   const source = readSource(messages.slice(evidenceWindowStart(messages)), path);
00073|   if (source === null) {
00074|     const read = toolFor(toolNames, Capability.Read);
00075|     return read === null ? null : planOne(read, readArguments(path));
00076|   }
00077|   const names = exportedFunctions(source);
00078|   const language = detect(task);
00079|   const values = [['path', path], ['count', String(names.length)],
00080|     ['names', names.map((name) => `\`${name}\``).join(', ')]];
00081|   const intent = names.length ? 'module_exports_listed' : 'module_exports_none';
00082|   return finalAnswer(renderResponse(intent, language, values) ?? renderResponse(intent, 'en', values));
00083| }
